remarks: Bright and inviting, this third-floor, south-facing 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo at Place at Lakeside offers lovely views of the courtyard and lake from the living room and oversized balcony. The spacious living room opens to a well-appointed kitchen with ample cabinetry and counter space. The generous bedroom features a walk-in closet, and the full bathroom includes a tub with a professionally installed walk-in door. A titled, heated underground parking stall with a storage cage is included, along with appliances and window coverings. This 55+ community offers games, card and party rooms, a library, an exercise room and a theatre. An indoor pedway connects directly to the adjacent Allen Gray building, where meals are available for purchase. Enjoy a short walk to Mill Woods Town Centre, Seniors  Centre, Library, banks, restaurants, and medical and professional offices. (id:67522)
